scenes.heading: How revenue splits and pricing typically work

sents.d: How revenue splits and pricing typically work
Most arrangements are commission-based, tied directly to what the creator earns.

Most creator management arrangements are structured as a percentage of net revenue (commonly somewhere in a wide range depending on scope of services, market, and creator size) rather than a flat fee, aligning the manager's income directly with the creator's success.
A narrower scope of work (e.g. scheduling only) generally commands a lower percentage than full-service management (messaging, growth, marketing, reporting combined).
Being transparent about exactly what's included at a given rate, and getting the split confirmed in writing before starting any work, avoids the most common source of disputes in this field.

take: Agree the split and scope in writing before starting.
